name: nearby-hpbars
description: Nearby mobiles health list: distance, HP % and notoriety colour per row, notoriety filters, follow, and two configurable quick-action buttons per mobile (Bandage, Heal, Greater Heal, Cure, Arch Cure, Remove Curse, Close Wounds, Cleansing Winds) that act on the current target cursor or cast/use directly. Collapsible, resizable, movable window.
